reg.title: Operator.
reg.intro: A new identity. It lives while the terminal is open: the key never touches the disk, and quitting makes you someone else.
reg.name: name
reg.pinIntro: Six digits. They confirm changing the PIN and starting again; ten wrong tries close entry until the paper code.
reg.codeTitle: Write this code down. We will not show it a second time.
reg.codeWhy: There is no e-mail and no password: lose this device and the paper code is the only way back. On paper — a screenshot lives on the device that gets lost.
reg.codeRepeat: type the second and the fourth groups
reg.codeWrong: the groups do not match the code above
loc.title: Where are you?
loc.intro1: The point is the feed's filter and the place your phrase goes out from.
loc.intro2: It lives until you quit: nothing is written to disk, and we will ask again next time.
feed.none: you have not written a phrase yet
feed.empty: nobody nearby right now. Widen the radius or come back later.
write.title: Your phrase
write.hint: It goes out from the point in the filter, and is checked before anyone sees it.
inbox.title: inbox
inbox.match: a match — waiting for your consent
chat.title: {name}, {age}
chat.codeHint: compare it aloud or in person: the same code means nobody is between you
common.rowFields: arrows up and down move between fields
common.rowActions: left and right choose an action, enter picks it
chat.codeChanged: the code has changed since you compared it — compare again
hidden.title: hidden phrases
block.what: the conversation ends for both of you, and a lifted block cannot be set again
statements.human: no automated check was used; a person decided
statements.automated: hidden automatically, by the number of complaints from different people; no person decided — write to us and a person will look
statements.appeal: reply to us, contact the Digital Services Coordinator, go to court
liked.title: liked
me.title: me
me.name: name
chat.expired: The span ran out; the conversation is gone.
away.pick: choose a duration — we will count what it costs
away.price: phrases to vanish: {phrases} · likes to be taken back: {likes} · conversations not to survive: {chats} of {of}
away.warning: Your phrases will vanish along with their likes, your likes on others' phrases and tables will be taken back, and offers to talk will burn. Conversations run on their own timers: this break is survived only by those whose span outlasts it, counting from your last message — how many, it says above. If you are sitting at a table, you will stand up from it — the game goes on without you. A phrase still waiting for its check will vanish with the rest. The hourly posting limit and the pause after refusals outlast the break: when you come back you get four free places, not a fresh hour.
away.line: You have stepped away. Phrases are down, conversations are waiting.
away.sure: you wanted a break; are you sure?
write.paused:
Five refusals in an hour — paused until {time}. The decision is automatic.
Until then nothing goes to checking:
phrases, table lines, a name change, an offer like while the name is not accepted, a hangman word.
Another refusal this hour — another 15 minutes.
The feed, likes on phrases and conversations work.
Ground: the Terms, §8 and §15. The pause ends by itself; if you disagree — the Digital Services Coordinator or a court.
write.hourly: Four phrases already said this hour. The next one can go at {time}.
write.rapid: Too many sends in a row.
write.hold: Checking what you sent earlier — the new one goes after the verdict.
write.live: Four phrases are already live. The next slot frees at {time}.
me.ageHint: your contacts will see the change
profile.nameFrozen: Your name changes only on a clean slate: while a phrase of yours is live or a conversation is open, it is frozen.
profile.ageDown: There is no way back from the 21+ band. Age is edited within the band; the 20/21 line is crossed only upwards.
profile.patchDay: Enough profile edits for now — you can again in {n} h.
card.hint: right — like, left — hide; hidden things come back in me · [enter] got it
pin.title: Change the PIN
pin.mismatch: That PIN does not match. Attempts left: {n}
pin.locked: Entry is closed until the paper code.
pin.wait: Too soon after the last attempt. Try again in {n} s.
reset.title: Start again
reset.warning: This identity closes for good, and a new one begins here.
reset.price: phrases to vanish: {phrases} · conversations and offers to end: {chats}
reset.code: The paper code becomes useless: nothing can raise this identity again.
restore.title: Paper code
restore.intro: Type the sixteen characters from your paper. Groups may be split by dashes or spaces.
restore.introHere: The paper code opens this device again. The PIN stays as it was; if you do not remember it, you will set a new one.
restore.bad: That is not a paper code: sixteen letters and digits.
restore.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {n} s.
restore.away: You stepped away: the code can be changed once you are back.
restore.refused: The node did not accept it ({status}).
restore.item: open this device with the paper code
reissue.title: New paper code
reissue.intro: First, the code written down now. It stops working once the new one is confirmed.
move.title: Moving the identity
move.intro: The identity will move to another device: another terminal or a browser. A nine-character code will appear here — it is typed there.
move.price: Here the identity will freeze: new messages will stop arriving, and the conversations on this device will become unreadable for good — even if you move the identity back here.
move.codeWhere: Type the code on the new device. Before the identity leaves, you will be asked here whether it is you.
move.codeLife: the code lives {n} s more and works once
move.nobody: Nobody from support will ever ask for this code.
move.asks: A device asks to move the identity
move.checkAsk: does it match the new device's screen?
move.leaves: Everything leaves: the name, the phrases, the conversations and the paper code. The device writes its name itself and it cannot be checked — compare the four characters.
move.rejected: The move is cancelled: the code is spent, the identity stayed on the old device.
move.twice: The code was typed twice — there was no move. If the second time was not you, somebody saw the code.
move.expired: The code expired — there was no move.
move.codeBad: The code does not match or has expired.
move.garbled: The new device sent something this code does not open. The code is spent, there was no move.
move.done: The identity has moved to another device. Here it is frozen: new messages will stop arriving, and the conversations on this device will become unreadable for good — even if you move the identity back here.
move.inIntro: On the device where the identity lives now, open the move — a nine-character code will appear there. Type it here.
move.deriving: deriving the keys from the code…
move.inWait: Compare these four characters with the old device's screen and press "it's me" there. Waiting here.
move.arrived: There is no history on this device — it is empty here for now. The earlier conversations are in place but silent until their key is reissued.
closed.moved: The identity was moved to another device; nothing of it is left here.
closed.update: The node speaks another version of the protocol. Update depth and start it again.
restore.hereIntro: Entry is open again and the PIN counter is back at ten. The old PIN still works.
restore.keepPin: I remember the PIN — go on
restore.forgotPin: I do not remember the PIN — set a new one
restore.newPinPrice: The old PIN will stop working. There is no history on this device anyway — nothing to lose.
chat.waitingHint: Lines wait in a queue without a ✓ and go to the other the moment they press “talk”. Quit depth and the queue is gone.
inbox.waiting: a match — waiting for an answer
like.namePending:
The name did not pass the check — the offer to talk was not sent.
Fix the name and it will go by itself while the offer lives.
table.title: table
table.open: no end-to-end encryption: the node sees the board and the lines, a line waits for moderation
table.stale: the board changed meanwhile — look again
table.notStarted: the game has not started yet
complaint.title: complaint: the discount was not given
complaint.private: only moderators see it; the venue learns one arrived, not from whom
table.name: name (optional)
table.standThere: stand up there and sit here
